question: List the creation date and age of the user that commented with webiste.
evidence: commented with webiste refers to the value contains 'http://'
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching users record.
gold: SELECT T2.CreationDate, T2.Age FROM comments AS T1 LEFT JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.text LIKE '%http://%'
gold0: SELECT T2.CreationDate, T2.Age FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.text LIKE '%http://%'

d.request: List the creation date and age of users whose comments have a website value containing `http://`, including comments with no matching users record.
d.sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.CreationDate, u.Age FROM comments AS c LEFT JOIN users AS u ON c.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.WebsiteUrl LIKE '%http://%' OR u.Id IS NULL;

b.request: For every comment whose text contains `http://`, list the commenter’s account creation date and age, including comments with no matching user record
b.sql: SELECT u.CreationDate, u.Age FROM comments AS c LEFT JOIN users AS u ON c.UserId = u.Id WHERE c.Text LIKE '%http://%';
